title.narrative: Accelerating Renewable Energy Adoption In OECS Countries

description.narrative: The project objective is twofold as it aims to support the Eastern Caribbean Solar Challenge by establishing a governance framework and building public awareness on the initiative. The project also aims to strengthen energy regulatory frameworks to support renewable energy uptake and assisting countries in meeting NDC targets related to RE.

This project will support the OECS in its implementation of the Sustainable Energy Framework and the Eastern Caribbean Solar Challenge by providing support to regional energy regulators and energy ministries in developing and improving policy and regulatory frameworks for renewable energy integration; providing direct support to electric utility customers in financing and developing rooftop solar PV facilities, and supporting OECS in operationalizing the Solar Challenge program.The project will be mainly funded through the Luxembourg SIDS CAP, but initially funded via core until the Lux project starts.
